title: NTA All India Ayush Post Graduate Entrance Test AIAPGET Admissions 2026 Result / Score Card
postName: All India Ayush Post Graduate Entrance Test (AIAPGET) 2026
vacancyDetails: AIAPGET 2026 result and score card released for admission to AYUSH postgraduate courses.
qualification: BAMS / BUMS / BSMS / BHMS or equivalent AYUSH qualification as per the official AIAPGET bulletin.
ageLimit: As per AIAPGET 2026 eligibility and admission rules.
applicationFee: General / UR: ₹2700; OBC-NCL / EWS: ₹2450; SC / ST / PH: ₹1800.

1. Visit the official AIAPGET result portal

shortDescription: NTA has released the AIAPGET 2026 result and score card for AYUSH PG admissions. Candidates can check and download their score card from the official portal.
content:
National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the AIAPGET 2026 Result / Score Card for admission to MD, MS and PG diploma courses in Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy.

Candidates can log in to the official AIAPGET result portal and download their score card after the result declaration. The final answer key and result notice are also available from the official NTA and examination-service links.

Important dates

  • Application begin: 10/07/2026
  • Last date to apply: 30/07/2026
  • Correction window: 01-02 August 2026
  • Exam date: 22 August 2026
  • Exam city details: 13 August 2026
  • Admit card available: 18 August 2026
  • Answer key available: 04 September 2026
  • Final answer key: 18 September 2026
  • Result declared: 18 September 2026

Use the official result portal to check the score card and verify the candidate details before counselling and admission formalities.
